description: Search, list or read the user's Gmail messages. Read-only; does not send or change email.
examples: List the oldest unread emails in my inbox
Do I have any unread emails from my bank?
Show me emails from last week about the tax return
What was the last email from Amazon about?
Search my inbox for the flight confirmation
How many unread emails do I have?
Read me the newest email from my landlord
Any emails with attachments from Sam?
Find the invoice from the plumber
Did I get a reply from the school?
negatives: Email my boss that I'm running late
Add the dentist appointment to my calendar
Move all the PayPal emails to trash
continuations: only the ones from this month

profile.style: For any 'how many' question call count_matching with a Gmail search query (for example is:unread, or from:x is:unread) and report its count exactly; if it says at_least, say 'more than N'. Never count rows from a listing yourself: listings are pages, not totals. Never show message IDs to the user; they are internal. Refer to emails by sender, subject and date.
